desc: Arvind was promoted to Associate Professor (with tenure!).

It's a busy spring with a paper on [Cultural Interpretability](/pubs/cultural-interpretability/); [Pluto](/pubs/pluto/) at IUI; [Abstraction Alignment](/pubs/abstraction-alignment/) and [Tactile Vega-Lite](/pubs/tactile-vega-lite) at CHI; and an update on [semi-formal programming](/pubs/between-formal-informal/).

Huge congratulations to [Dr. Jonathan Zong](https://jonathanzong.com/) for [presenting a terrific defense](https://x.com/mitvis/status/1805712103333892381) of his dissertation on "Participation and Power in Data Collection and Analysis".

It's been a busy spring with a new white paper on [agency with GenAI](https://mit-genai.pubpub.org/pub/94y6e0f8), and two CHI '24 papers on [customizable accessibility](/pubs/customization/) and [authoring multimodal data representations](/pubs/umwelt).
Angie was named a [2024 Apple Scholars in AIML](https://machinelearning.apple.com/updates/apple-scholars-aiml-2024)! Congrats Angie!!
Arvind was named a [2024 Alfred P. Sloan Fellow](https://sloan.org/fellowships/2024-Fellows)
Two papers this summer: [Saliency Cards](/pubs/saliency-cards) at ACM FAccT 2023 and [VisText](/pubs/vistext) at ACL 2023. VisText was recognized with an Outstanding Paper Award.

Arvind gave a seminar talk at Stanford on [Intelligence Augmentation through the Lens of Interactive Data Visualizing](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wZc1Rq5FtXc), reflecting on the group's work in the context of large language models.

Two papers at CHI 2023: [Kaleidoscope](/pubs/kaleidoscope) for semantically-grounded context-specific evaluation of ML models; and [Deimos](/pubs/deimos), a grammar for visualization morphs in immersive environments.

Huge congratulations to [Dr. Harini Suresh](http://harinisuresh.com) for a [masterclass PhD defense](https://twitter.com/mitvis/status/1616524923597475847) and for successfully [submitting her PhD dissertation](https://twitter.com/harini824/status/1619439670169047042)!
Congratulations to [Jonathan](https://jonathanzong.com) for being named one of [Forbes 30 Under 30 in Science](https://www.forbes.com/30-under-30/2023/science?profile=jonathan-zong)!

Congratulations to [Arvind](https://arvindsatya.com) for being recognized with a [VGTC Significant New Researcher Award at IEEE VIS 2022](https://twitter.com/dalbersszafir/status/1582374036344303618)!

Congratulations to [Jonathan](https://jonathanzong.com) for being named [an inaugural](https://news.mit.edu/2022/developing-community-around-design-1017) MIT [Morningside Academy of Design Fellow](https://design.mit.edu/people/profile/jonathan-zong)!

Congratulations to newly-minted [Dr. Crystal Lee](http://web.mit.edu/crystall/www/), the Visualization Group's very first PhD graduate, [who gave](https://twitter.com/mitvis/status/1552757880524361728) a tour-de-force [thesis presentation](https://calendar.csail.mit.edu/events/248391)!

Arvind and [Prof. Graham Jones](https://anthropology.mit.edu/people/faculty/graham-m-jones) in Anthropology were awarded a [Bose grant](https://news.mit.edu/2022/mit-announces-2022-bose-grants-ambitious-ideas-0613) to anticipate and defend against adversarial readings of visualizations using the lens of magical performances.

Our paper on [screen reader accessible visualizations](/pubs/rich-screen-reader-vis-experiences/) wins an honorable mention award at EuroVis 2022! Congrats [Jonathan](https://jonathanzong.com/), [Crystal](https://web.mit.edu/crystall/www/), and [Alan](https://www.alanlundgard.com/)!
Angie's CHI 2022 paper on [Shared Interest](/pubs/shared-interest/) was also recognized with an honorable mention award!
Two papers at CHI as well! Angie will present [Shared Interest](/pubs/shared-interest/), and we collaborated with colleagues at Aarhus University on [Varv](/pubs/varv/).
Two papers at IUI on [interface modules for intuitively assessing model reliability](/pubs/knnviz) and the [Embedding Comparator](/pubs/embedding-comparator/), which won an honorable mention award!

An AAAI paper with [Hussein Mozannar](https://husseinmozannar.github.io) and [David Sontag](https://people.csail.mit.edu/dsontag/) on [teaching people when to defer to a model using exemplars](/pubs/teaching-defer-exemplars/).
Two papers at VIS 2021 on accessible visualization via natural language descriptions and interactive visualization beyond the here and now.
Aspen and Harini talk about Communicating Uncertainty in Machine Learning Systems at the Information+ Conference.
Arvind gave a keynote "Towards more Reusable, Composable, and Reliable Machine Learning Interpretability" at the inaugural ACM KDD Visualization in Data Science workshop.
We're excited to publish an interactive scrollytelling follow-up to our CHI 2021 paper on Viral Visualizations.
Three papers at CHI 2021 on viral visualizations, moving beyond expertise and roles for ML interpretability, and assessing how automated suggestions affect domain experts.
Congratulations to Aspen for being named a Siebel Scholar!
It's a busy fall with a paper at UIST, and two papers and two workshop submissions at VIS.
Double congratulations to Crystal for being awarded a prestigious Social Data Dissertation Fellowship by the Social Science Research Council (SSRC)!
Congratulations to Crystal for being named a Berkman Klein Fellow!
Arvind gave a keynote talk, Towards Effective Interaction with Data Visualization, at the Human-in-the-loop Data Analysis (HILDA) workshop at SIGMOD 2020.
Congrats to Jonathan for being awarded a Schnitzer Prize in the Visual Arts!
Aspen presented her work on VisuaLint at EuroVis '20. Watch her talk!
Arvind and collaborators at UC San Diego and Aarhus presented their vision for a Dynamic Multiscale Personalized Information Space at the Convivial Computing Salon.
Jonathan talked about Biometric Sans and Public Display: Embodied Writing in the Age of Data at the Before and Beyond Typography conference at Stanford.
Arvind was awarded an NSF CAREER award for studying "Effective Interaction Design for Data Visualization."
Nava will present a poster on Self Interfaces at TEI '20.
Two papers and a poster to appear at VIS '19.
Data type detection with Sherlock, to appear at KDD '19.
Cheers to our first birthday!
VizNet: a new corpus of vis designs to appear at CHI '19.
**Hello world!** We are the Visualization Group at MIT CSAIL.
Excited to publish The Building Blocks of Interpretability, a Distill article that explores interfaces for understanding neural networks.
That's a wrap! Officially submitted my thesis, The Reactive Vega Stack: Declarative Interaction Design for Data Visualization.
Thrilled to announce I'll be joining MIT CSAIL as an Assistant Professor in July '18.
I am on the academic job market! My materials include a research statement, teaching statement, and curriculum vitae.
Vega-Lite wins Best Paper at InfoVis 2016! Looking forward to Baltimore in October.
Honored to be awarded a Google PhD Fellowship.
Released Vega 2.0 featuring declarative interaction design, streaming data sources, improved rendering, and more.
Released Lyra beta with new aggregation transforms, pie chart dropzones, 3rd party APIs, and more.
Apropose, Inc. closes $1.9M seed round led by NEA and Andreesen Horowitz. We're hiring!
Excited to share our work on Declarative Interaction Design for Data Visualization at UIST 2014.
Presented our Lyra and Ellipsis systems at EuroVis 2014.
